root_cause: The existing daily-winner ensure RPC upsert overwrote asset_manifest/provider/next_action for a WAITING_ASSET job when asset_url and openart_resource_id were absent, without recognizing an already claimed OpenArt history or an independent rejection.
fix: Use a conflict UPDATE guard that only updates unclaimed empty QUEUED/WAITING_ASSET/WAITING_PROVIDER_CONNECTION records; otherwise read back original ID without mutating status, attempts, provider history, rejection or proof. Existing media router alone transitions accepted new candidate.
prevention: Retain original immutable claimed history and real face >=0.940 / temporal >=0.900 quality gates. Never retry identical rejected bytes, silently clear errors, create parallel publisher/scheduler or mark a channel live without provider ID plus independent readback.
privacy: public-safe cause and synthetic replay only; private Brain occurrences remain private
